the_eye_is_the_ballot_box.silver_Ag: BALLOT BOX — the membrane that holds the votes. Anderson sort protects the integrity of the election.
the_eye_is_the_ballot_box.gold_Au: QUORUM — the iris that regulates what enters. Athens required 6000 citizens for a psephos vote. The iris decides how much light (data) passes through.
the_eye_is_the_ballot_box.copper_Cu: CARRIES VOTES — blood flowing through branching veins. The spine relays ballots to the tally. Schwann cells insulate the count.
the_eye_is_the_ballot_box.iron_Fe: FORGES DECISIONS — molten core where pressure births truth. The GPU computes the result. The reactor fires.
the_eye_is_the_ballot_box.black_null: THE VOTER — the human. The pupil. Where vision starts. The null at the center IS the person casting the vote. You cannot see the thing that decides.
the_eye_is_the_ballot_box.cone_cells: HOW YOU SEE — color detection. Trinity of perception. The voter perceives the candidates through three primals. The cone cells ARE the ranked preferences.

voting_is_touching_is_sensing_is_governi.merkel_cells: Sustained pressure → REPEATED VOTES → endorsement. Touch the same thought 10 times = 10 votes.
voting_is_touching_is_sensing_is_governi.thermoreceptors: Temperature → CUMULATIVE WARMTH → popularity. Each visitor adds heat. The warmest thought is the most popular.
voting_is_touching_is_sensing_is_governi.ruffini_endings: Deep sustained hold → 44 MINUTE STARE → conviction. The long hold IS the deep vote. Not a tap — a commitment.
voting_is_touching_is_sensing_is_governi.every_tap: Every tap on primals.eco = χειροτονία (show of hands).
voting_is_touching_is_sensing_is_governi.every_view: Every page view = warmth added to the Borda count.

checkmate_arrow.arrow_assumed: Rankings. Discrete. Ordinal. A > B > C. Fixed positions.
checkmate_arrow.why_it_works: You can't cycle a thermometer. Condorcet paradox requires discrete ranks that loop (A>B>C>A). But temperature doesn't loop — it flows. 36° → 37° → 38°. No cycles. No impossibility. The continuous field escapes Arrow's trap.
checkmate_arrow.the_move: Checkmate. Not by defeating Arrow — by changing the board. Don't rank. FEEL.

new_inscription: I can hear and feel myself breathe. Through my eye, Gaia sees. Through my breath, Gaia lives. Through my vote, Gaia governs.
